dimensions.basis: The spec has observable scenarios for label-only uncertainty, reconciliation of distinct contexts, unconfirmed responses, and loss of authority/coverage; design and tasks add source-proof and bounded rollout conditions.

Tasks cover the protected read-only view, stable projection, refresh/history/scope/accessibility, backend/browser regressions, shared controls, source proof, full delivery, and prohibit closing #51 on a partial checkpoint.

The design identifies regression cases for repeated/distinct requests, unknown labels/actors, stale and incomplete data, revoked scope and late responses, source resolution/replacement, rejected or uncertain responses, safe rendering, keyboard and narrow-browser behavior.
The plan calls for npm run verify, configured CI, and review of all eleven Done dimensions; execution evidence is correctly deferred to implementation.

The plan reuses authenticated workspace routes, connected-user source authorization and generation/stop guards; it adds no credential, persistence, execution, or local policy authority and specifies revocation/late-response behavior.

The read-only first slice reuses existing factory and issue readers. It preserves ADR-0006's repository-owned execution boundary and explicitly leaves ADR-0008 proposed; complete control behavior waits on released/adopted shared controls.
Tasks require updating realized architecture/runbook and preview evidence; no implementation documentation is incorrectly claimed as already complete.

Cited accepted product intent is reflected: source labels are not questions or authority, ordinary comments do not resolve waits, action/receipt semantics stay shared, and product artifacts/ADR status remain unchanged.

Tasks distinguish deterministic/configured CI and implementation evidence from actual connected-user pending/resolved source traces, which remain required for whole-issue acceptance and are not demanded at this Plan gate.

The plan explicitly requires independent planning acceptance, later review of all eleven dimensions, and preserves owner/source decision boundaries; it does not substitute this review for protected gates.

The proposal states bounded/partial collection and unavailable source semantics; design calls out unsupported actions, unknown actors/questions, stale data, source limitations, deferred physical-phone rehearsal, and no whole-issue closure before shared source proof.
